new_value: Resolved as a side effect of persona-okek (4698b8a), not fixed directly. OidcCachedAttestor no longer implements prove() at all — no attestor does; only the trait's declining default at lib.rs:108 remains. oidc.rs constructs no SignedAssertion, so there is no code path that hands a caller a live IdP bearer token. Reopen if a real OIDC prove() is written: the requirement then is that it must not return the IdP token itself, and must bind to the challenge (see .116).
